li.label: protected an ally
li.description: I carried a fallen ally to safety. Protecting those in need is an honorable duty.

li.label: honorable victory
li.description: I defeated a standing enemy in open combat, not a helpless captive.

li.label: our House broke its oath
li.description: Our House failed a sworn obligation. What worth is our word if we do not keep it?

li.label: feudal duty fulfilled
li.description: Our House served its liege and fulfilled its obligation. We have earned respect through service.

li.label: lawful succession
li.description: The rightful successor has inherited the leadership and dignity of our House. Our line endures.

li.label: rightful rule violated
li.description: Our House displaced its living ruler or passed over the lawful successor. Titles and succession must mean something.

li.label: recognized House authority
li.description: A living, free head leads our House. Their office deserves respect.

li.label: House authority in doubt
li.description: Our House has no living, free head to lead it.

li.label: no rightful House head
li.description: Our House needs a living, free ruler. We must recognize a successor or restore our captive head.
